# YESPYQ

> YESPYQ is a previous-year-question (PYQ) practice platform for Indian exams: UPSC CSE Prelims, JEE (Main & Advanced), NEET-UG, SSC CGL, Defence exams, and school Board exams.

## Site
- Homepage: https://yespyq.com/
- Practice / UPSC PYQs: https://yespyq.com/pyq/
- All exams: https://yespyq.com/exams/
- Subjects: https://yespyq.com/subjects/
- Blog: https://yespyq.com/blog/
- PYQ Pass (₹149/year): https://yespyq.com/pyq-pass/
- About: https://yespyq.com/about/
- Terms: https://yespyq.com/terms/
- Privacy: https://yespyq.com/privacy-policy/

## Product facts
- 19,500+ authentic previous year questions
- Six exam families: UPSC, JEE, NEET, SSC CGL, Defence, Boards
- Single-correct MCQs only (four options, one answer)
- Browse free; PYQ Pass unlocks answers, explanations and full practice features for one year
- Independent study tool — not affiliated with UPSC, NTA, SSC, or any exam body
